structured_output.what_is_happening: "AnthropicAI" ($Anthropic) is an unofficial Solana token. It borrows the name of the real AI company and links to Anthropic's real X handle (@AnthropicAI). Its website link is a t.co redirect to anthropic.com, so the project has no site or socials of its own. It was created on a Meteora virtual curve and "migrated" in the same second (created and migrated at unix 1790126065). The PumpSwap pool opened around 01:14 UTC on Sep 23 with about $300k of liquidity already in place. In the ~35 minutes before detection it traded about $2.9M at roughly $1M market cap, a turnover of about 9.5x. The obvious hook is Anthropic's launch of Claude Opus 5.5, announced on X about 8–9 hours earlier (my estimate from the post ID, around 16:30 UTC Sep 22). Anthropic has also been in the news around a UN Security Council AI session on Sep 23. Nothing ties the token to Anthropic. Multiple other "AnthropicAI" tokens were launched minutes before this one and now show near-zero liquidity. At least 10 same-name clones exist in the packet.

narrative.description: A brand-impersonation memecoin riding Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 launch (Sep 22) and general Anthropic news. The real event is big and current. Top AI and finance accounts covered Opus 5.5 widely on X. But the token has no link to Anthropic, which does not issue tokens.
narrative.why_spreading: The underlying news (Opus 5.5 launch, high engagement on X) draws people who search tickers for 'Anthropic' on Solana. This token won a launch race among several simultaneous clones, probably because it was seeded with deep liquidity. I found no organic posts mentioning this contract. Unique buyers (1,550) far outnumber unique sellers (158), and there were 75 bundler wallets, 97 rat-trader wallets and 153 graph insiders. That pattern points to coordinated or bot-driven buying, not people discovering the token on their own.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is the only Anthropic-named clone with real liquidity and volume right now. Clones created minutes earlier (2fjpA..., 74Bg...) show liquidity under $1. None of them is official. RugCheck flags it as a 'Copycat token'. GMGN reports that 700 other tokens use the same image.
token_connection.competing_tokens: More than 10 same-name 'AnthropicAI' tokens (2fjpA…, 74Bg…, 3u7a…, 9MJY…, GDSk…, S1e3…, 9nvV…, and ANTH-ticker clones), almost all with dead liquidity. There is also Anthropic PreStocks (Pren1F…), a separate pre-IPO exposure token that Anthropic has publicly called invalid.

authenticity.evidence: 1) GMGN flags 75 bundler wallets and 97 rat-trader wallets. RugCheck found 153 graph insiders, including one transfer network of 64 wallets. 2) The token went from creation to migration in the same second, with about $300k of pre-seeded liquidity, which suggests an organized launch rather than organic bonding. 3) The creator's status is 'creator_close' (the dev has exited). 4) GeckoTerminal shows 1,550 unique buyers against 158 sellers, with average buys under $1k and 9.5x hourly turnover, which looks like bot or wash flow. 5) Searches for the contract address, the ticker, Reddit and Telegram turned up no organic discussion. 6) There is a history of repeated AnthropicAI clones that are now dead.
authenticity.uncertainty: Search engines index X poorly, and private Telegram call groups are invisible to me. GMGN reports top-10 holders at 1.4% while GeckoTerminal reports 96%, so the concentration data conflicts. The GeckoTerminal figure probably includes the pool and curve accounts.

structured_output.counterargument: Opus 5.5 is a genuinely big, current news event, and the UN AI session keeps Anthropic in headlines through Sep 23. This token is clearly the liquidity winner among the clones. It has about $300k in liquidity, zero tax, renounced mint and freeze authority, and no paid DexScreener boosts. More than 1,500 unique buyers in an hour is real breadth for a new launch. AI-brand memecoins sometimes run for hours on news momentum, and with the price still near its all-time high at detection, momentum traders could push it further before insiders exit.

The contract search returned nothing. The project 'site' is a t.co redirect to anthropic.com, the real company's site, not a project site. GMGN returned 403. I have DexScreener and GeckoTerminal API data. Discord was not searched separately because the project lists no Discord.

structured_output.thesis: This is a brand-impersonation copycat that won a launch race among several simultaneous 'AnthropicAI' clones. It has pre-seeded liquidity, a creator who has exited, large bundler and insider networks, unlocked LP, and heavy bot-like turnover. It is loosely riding Anthropic's Opus 5.5 launch from about 9 hours earlier. The news is real, but the token has no real connection to it, and I found no organic discussion of this contract. The earlier clones all went to near-zero liquidity. Expect attention to fade within hours.
